top_signals.title: Eyre: US Has to Cut Losses In Iran War
top_signals.summary: President Trump says the US will start new negotiations with Iran after he called off a planned attack on Iran partially in response to pleas from US allies in the Middle East, including Saudi Arabia. Alan Eyre, Distinguished Diplomatic Fellow at the Middle East Institute & Former Senior US diplomat told Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the probability of a deal with Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
